dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Everyone calls me Master Qin. You can go with that name.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I'm a martial artist from Liyue hired by the Communications Office. Right now, I'm working as a bodyguard for a merchant called Li Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: I had wanted to visit Inazuma before. That's why I took this job.
